北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 2℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and cold, feels like 2℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云略凉，体感 4℃，注意防寒哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and a bit chilly, feels like 4℃. Mind the cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微冷，体感 4℃。出门别忘带件外套！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and slightly cold, feels like 4℃. Don't forget a jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云舒适，体感 16℃。早晚温差大，注意哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 16℃. Mind the temperature difference.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云好天气，体感 17℃。小心湿度大，注意防潮。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and nice, feels like 17℃. Be aware of high humidity.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云略冷，体感 2℃。风力稍大，多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and slightly cold at 2℃. It's a bit windy, layer up.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴沉，体感 2℃。别忘添衣，小心着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels only 2℃. Remember to add clothes to avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 7℃。湿润微凉，注意保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 7℃. It's damp and cool, stay warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 6℃。能见度低，出行请小心。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has fog, feels like 6℃. Low visibility, please travel carefully.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 6℃。空气较干燥，记得补水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 6℃. The air is dry, remember to hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 9℃。注意防湿保暖，多喝水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Stay warm and hydrated.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾，体感 -16℃！寒气逼人，务必全副武装。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy and feels -16℃! It's freezing, be fully bundled up.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -4℃。有阳光但依旧冷，多穿点。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -4℃. It's cold despite the sun, dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 12℃。早晚微凉，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 12℃. It's cool in the morning/evening, add layers.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 9℃。风力有点大，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 9℃. It's a bit windy, mind the wind chill.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 1℃。能见度差，出行慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like 1℃. Poor visibility, drive/walk slowly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -2℃。风大体感更冷，多加衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -2℃. Windy and colder, layer up.
